Build prompt

Rebuild this interaction 1:1: CRED money's floating status pill - a black rounded pill hovering above the bottom edge updates its message ("Money received", "Subscription renewed", "Payment due soon") with a vertical 3D text flip while the pill width animates to fit each new string and its status dot changes color.

## Integration
Integration: stack-agnostic spec - springs given as stiffness/damping, timed motions as duration + curve; map every value to your framework and animation library of choice.

## Scene
CRED "share the privilege" screen (mint header, black "Invite friends" button, MORE ACTIONS list). Floating just above the home indicator: a black pill with a colored dot, status text, and a right arrow.

## Motion spec
Pattern: self-resizing pill with vertical flip text swap.
- Pill floats with a subtle idle bob (translateY +/-2px, ~2s loop).
- Message change: the old text flips away vertically (rotateX 0 -> -90deg, ~200ms, ease-in) as the new text flips up from below (rotateX 90 -> 0, ~200ms, ease-out), like a split-flap board.
- The pill width tweens to the new string width (~250ms, ease-in-out) during the flip.
- The status dot swaps color per state (green for received/renewed, red for due soon) with a quick scale pop (0.8 -> 1, ~200ms).
- Arrow stays pinned at the pill's right edge through the resize.

## Calibration
- Flip axis is horizontal through the text center - letters pivot like a flap, not a slide.
- Width animation and flip run together; neither waits for the other.

## Reduced motion
Text crossfades (150ms); width tweens as normal; no rotation.

## Don't miss
- The pill never jumps - center stays fixed while width grows symmetrically.
- Each message pair (text + dot color) is a distinct state, not a marquee.
